headline: Ecopetrol Appoints Gladys Vega as Vice President of Organizational Talent
summary: Ecopetrol appointed Gladys Vega, a psychologist from Pontificia Universidad Javeriana with specialization in human development, as Vice President of Organizational Talent.
why: Management changes at state-controlled energy giants like Ecopetrol are closely tracked for governance and corporate strategy implications.

impacts.name: Ecopetrol
impacts.why: Executive leadership appointments shape corporate governance and human capital policies.
